name: Dreadnauts
summary: Dreadnauts is a roguelite FPS focused on unique Source-engine inspired movement and combat. It currently features a rocket launcher and a laser rifle that both allow for extremely versatile mobility, and you can perform moves such as bunny hopping, grappling hook swings, and even sync jumps. Pair the movement with 80+ roguelite augments, and every run is an opportunity to experiment with different builds.
